description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/mpas/rules/fv_gradient_edge — the mimetic dual of fv_divergence_cell: an edge-normal two-point gradient of a cell scalar via a pure connectivity map over the edges axis (no makearray regions, no ragged contraction — every edge reads exactly its two flanking cells). Every binding loads fixture.esm (metaparameters folded at the import edge to the level-0 mesh sizes), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST for the model: grad(phi) replaced by the edge-normal finite-volume aggregate (output over edges, difference of the two cellsOnEdge-gathered cell values over dcEdge), zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, and zero surviving metaparameter names. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
